changelog:
Initial release of “知识消化助手” (knowledge-digest):

- Converts learning resources (PDFs, textbooks, topics) into personalized, multi-modal study materials: handwritten notes PDF, minimalist quiz HTML, slides (PDF+PPTX), mind map, and audio lessons.
- Adjusts content depth and style automatically based on education level (primary, junior, senior, university/professional).
- Default output includes mind map, slides (PDF only), and quiz if the user does not specify format.
- Implements a stepwise workflow: collects user materials/info, parses structure and core concepts, generates selected formats, and delivers only file paths (no previews, no embedded media).
- Strict rules for content parsing, output quality, and personalization are detailed for all formats.
